## Project Summary

This is a professional resume website for Jon Williams built with:
- Next.js 15 (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Lucide React (icons)

## Key Files to Customize

1. **src/data/resume-data.ts** - Update all your personal information, experience, skills, projects, education
2. **public/resume.pdf** - Add your PDF resume for download
3. **src/app/layout.tsx** - Update metadata (title, description)

## Development

- Run `npm run dev` to start the development server at http://localhost:3000
- The site includes dark/light mode toggle
- All sections are responsive and SEO optimized

## Deployment

Deploy to Vercel for free:
1. Push to GitHub
2. Import repository to Vercel
3. Deploy automatically

See README.md for complete documentation.
